description: Source file defining the main class NodeRuntime, responsible for managing gateway connections, device operations, chat interactions, and UI integration for the Android app in the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: NodeRuntime
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing gateway connections, device operations, chat, voice, UI, and overall runtime state of the Android app.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPrompt
classes.description: Data class representing a trust prompt for TLS fingerprint verification.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Serializable data class used for rendering the home canvas UI state.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Serializable data class representing an agent card for the home canvas UI.

classes.name: GatewayAgentSummary
classes.description: Data class summarizing gateway agent info for UI display.

classes.name: HomeCanvasGatewayState
classes.description: Enum representing the current gateway connection state for UI logic.

methods.name: resolveNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs the main session key based on device ID and optionally an agent ID.

methods.name: refreshHomeCanvasOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes branding and agent list if connected to gateway.

methods.name: requestCanvasRehydrate
methods.description: Initiates a request to restore or rehydrate the canvas state.

methods.description: Connects to a specified gateway endpoint.

methods.name: connectWithAuth
methods.description: Connects to gateway with specified authentication details.

methods.name: beginConnect
methods.description: Starts connection process, handling TLS verification if needed.

methods.description: Accepts the TLS fingerprint trust prompt and proceeds to connect.
